children: CDT Equity entered into a senior secured convertible promissory note with J.J. Astor & Co. for $2,126,250, maturing Mar 1, 2027 and amortizing in 24 weekly installments. The company received $1,575,000 before fees, with net proceeds of $1,501,850, and issued warrants for 3,468,500 shares at a $0.25 exercise price, expiring in five years. The note is secured by a first-priority lien, features a conversion price at 70% of the lowest 20-day VWAP or a $0.05 floor (subject to resets), and includes ownership caps. Issuance of conversion and warrant shares is subject to stockholder approval under Nasdaq rules, to be sought by Oct 31, 2026 if requested.
: Senior secured convertible promissory note and stock purchase warrants
